item.title: Yuri no Hana Gensou Kitan ~Towa no Ai o Kimi ni Chikau~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shining Star Lily’s
  • 発売日: 2010-06-11
  • スコア: 6.43/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 百合の花幻想奇譚～永久の愛を君に誓う～
  • 英語名: Yuri no Hana Gensou Kitan Towa no Ai o Kimi ni Chikau

あらすじ

One summer day, in gentle rain…

Yuuna Hibiki saw two girls kiss lips tenderly.

One young girl with green hair, Mai Himeno.

Yuuna’s rival.

The other, Chisa Hayase.

Yuuna’s true love.

To see her heart’s desire kissing another…

That scene shocked Yuuna.

But she was powerless to change it.

item.title: Yuri no Hana Tankyuu Club ~Kindan no Triangle~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shining Star Lily’s
  • 発売日: 2008-10-04
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 百合の花探求クラブ～禁断のトライアングル～
  • 英語名: Yuri no Hana Tankyuu Club Kindan no Triangle

あらすじ

The “Lily Flower Research Club” in a prestigious all-girls school is actually the front for the lesbian affair of Mei and Mai, the only members of the club.

But one day the two lovers receive a visit (and an application to the club) from Honami, the pure and naive idol of the school, who mistakenly believes their club is the real thing.
